input.free_text_description: This system is a file management platform that serves User, Candidate roles. It exposes interfaces for managing hello, index, list file. Secondary concerns include search functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a User, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a User, I want to interact with hello functionality, so that I can accomplish my hello-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with fast json functionality, so that I can accomplish my fast json-related tasks.
